errors.quote: Total on-duty time used today: 14.5 hours
errors.explanation: Total on-duty time includes driving (10.5 hours) plus on-duty not driving (1.5 hours), which equals 12.0 hours as correctly listed in the summary section, not 14.5 hours.
errors.fix: Total on-duty time used today: 12.0 hours

errors.quote: Post-trip vehicle inspection completed at 19:30 at Memphis staging yard
errors.explanation: Federal regulations (49 CFR § 396.11) require the driver to record vehicle condition and explicitly certify whether any safety-related defect was found or that no defect was found at the completion of each day's work, but the line omits the driver's vehicle condition declaration.
errors.fix: Post-trip vehicle inspection completed at 19:30 at Memphis staging yard with condition certified satisfactory
